method.termination: Only worker returned by an owned player endpoint; held OS identity, executable identity and parent PID checked before kill. Linux pidfd-SIGKILL; Windows same held process handle TerminateProcess(197).
method.release: Status-only automatic producer release before SDK.close/Cancel. Actual filesClosed receipts and absent cache required; decoder status queried afterwards.
method.timing: releaseAfterKillSeconds is sum of measured worker termination/OS-exit interval and subsequent status-only automatic release interval; both included in the <2 s assertion. Playback terminal proof is additionally awaited, not silently counted as the same measurement.
method.independentAndRetry: Second real player continues with same IDs. Original SHA unchanged; test writer physically appends and publishes updated SHA/ranges, late old events rejected, explicit retry uses new IDs in the same player process.
